buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION 1. Industrial Oxygen Gas: Industrial Oxygen Gas shall conform to IS: 309 (Latest). 2. Industrial D.A. Gas: Industrial D.A. Gas shall conform to IS: 308 (Latest). 3. Test Report: A valid Test Report from a Central Government / NABL / ILAC accredited laboratory, establishing co nformity of the offered product with the specifications prescribed under the relevant Indian Standard (La test), shall be submitted by the bidder. 4. PESO/Explosive Licence: The bidder shall submit a valid PESO/Explosive Licence for filling, storage, and transportation of gas cyli nders. 5. Gas Cylinders: Gas cylinders shall conform to the Gas Cylinder Rules, 1981, any other rules currently applicable, and t he specifications approved by the Chief Controller of Explosives, Government of India. 6. Approved Cylinder Design: The gases shall be compressed into cylinders of an approved design, as per the latest notification of the G overnment of India or any other duly constituted authority. 7. Marking, Painting and Labelling: The marking, painting, and labelling of cylinders containing the gases shall be in accordance with the requi rements prescribed under the applicable notification and with such modifications as may be ordered from t ime to time by the Chief Inspector of Explosives, Government of India, or any other duly constituted authority. 8. Examination of Cylinders and Porous Substances:

Examination of cylinders and porous substances shall be carried out by the bidder as per the Gas Cylinde r Rules, 1981, and as laid down in Red Tariff No. 20. 9. Periodic Examination and Testing: All cylinders shall be examined and tested periodically as per the Gas Cylinder Rules, 1981. __________________________________________________________________ ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS __________________________________________________________________ 1. Delivery Period: The delivery of the gases shall be made on an “as and when required” basis for a period of 180 days. 2. Lifting/Delivery: Arrangement for lifting of cylinders within a range of 75 km from Regional Store, Piparwar Area, shall be the responsibility of the consignee. The bidder shall ensure delivery of the cylinders within the specified range. 3. Certificates: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must possess a valid ISO 9001 Certification. The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates, including certificates/test repo rts for IS 308 and IS 309, and other certificates/documents as prescribed in the Product Specification giv en in the bid document. The bidder's offer shall be liable for rejection in case any of the certificates/documents sought in the Bid D ocument, ATC, or Corrigendum, if any, are not uploaded. 4. Guarantee/Warranty: The materials shall be covered under the manufacturer’s warranty, and the supplier shall be responsible fo r any defects in the supplied products, including non-compliance with the basic characteristics as per the o rder specifications. The materials supplied shall conform to the order specifications and shall be free from defects in material, design, and workmanship. Warranty Replacement: The manufacturer shall submit an undertaking that the materials shall be replaced free of cost in case the same are found to be of sub-standard quality, within 10 days of receipt of intimation. 5. Eligibility: The bidder must be a manufacturer/dealer of industrial gases, i.e., D.A. Gas conforming to IS: 308 (i ncluding latest amendments) and O₂ Gas conforming to IS: 309 (including latest amendments). Procurement of D.A. and O₂ shall be made from the same supplier, and the bidders shall be evaluated on a combined L-1 basis. 6. Initial Supply and Subsequent Requirement: After issuance of the contract, the bidder shall provide a minimum of 10 Nos. D.A. Gas Cylinders and 2 0 Nos. O₂ Gas Cylinders in returnable cylinders from the date of receipt of the Supply Order. The remaini ng quantities shall be supplied as and when required. 7. Inspection: Inspection and acceptance of the industrial gases supplied shall be carried out at the consignee end. 8. Stock: In order to meet urgent demands and ensure timely supply of materials against the contract during its curr ency, the bidder shall maintain sufficient stock of the items covered under the scope of supply. Free Rental Period: For supply of gases in cylinders, the bidder shall provide a free rental period of 15 days for the supplie d cylinders. 9. Other Charges: In case of any loss or damage to the cylinder, valve, or spare parts, the following maximum charge

s shall be applicable: a) Replacement cost of cylinder, if lost or damaged: ₹10,500/- + GST @ 18% b) Cylinder Valve: ₹780/- + GST @ 18% c) Cylinder Cap: ₹330/- + GST @ 18% d) Spindle: ₹150/- + GST @ 18% e) Gland Nut: ₹150/- + GST @ 18% f) Safety Guard Plug: ₹150/- + GST @ 18% g) Washer: ₹150/- + GST @ 18% h) Cylinder Rent per day beyond the free rental period of 15 days: ₹3/- + GST @ 18% 10. Non-Return of Cylinder: Any cylinder not returned within 90 days shall be considered as lost. 11. General Terms and Conditions: All other terms and conditions shall be as per Company norms. 12. Jurisdiction: Any dispute whatsoever arising out of or in connection with the contract shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the competent courts at Ranchi, Jharkhand only. . 3. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 4. Generic Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 5. Generic Supplier shall ensure that the Invoice is raised in the name of Consignee with GSTIN of Consignee only. 6. Generic While generating invoice in GeM portal, the seller must upload scanned copy of GST invoice and the screenshot of GST portal confirming payment of GST. 7. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 8. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support.

9. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 10. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 11. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document. 12. Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): Not Applicable Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: Staff Officer(E&M), Piparwar Area or his Authorized Representative 13.
